content: ffmpeg libopus: -application voip favors speech intelligibility at low bitrate (SILK-leaning); default -application audio favors fidelity. compression_level 0-10, default 10 (highest quality/slowest). Recommended for spoken word/podcast/audiobook: 32-48kbps mono voip mode is described as clean/natural, largely indistinguishable from higher bitrates for speech. FLAC is lossless, no bitrate; use -compression_level (0-12 native ffmpeg flac encoder) to trade CPU time for file size.
